rules: Validate all seven fields before every phase; child phases may only narrow.
Start from P57 exact head 6eecaa4208b67aea29781d90d87ecf12ddb55868 so blocked evidence remains immutable and visible in the eventual PR.
Run exactly one network preflight before launching a candidate batch.
Do not launch a batch when preflight fails; diagnose within the ten-preconnect-failure ceiling.
Use a unique temporary browser profile for each live round and destroy it before the next round.
Allow only first-party TikTok session cookies required for public rendering; never read, log, export, persist or replay cookie values.
Do not store browser cache, storage state, raw netlog, request/response headers or raw response bodies.
Every retained record requires stable video ID, canonical public URL, topic qualification and official TikTok verification.
Round two must use a fresh context and reproduce the final record identities before any adapter, registry, manifest or fixture is created.
A challenge, login wall, CAPTCHA or anti-bot control is a hard stop; do not interact with or bypass it.
Any scope widening requires a new Human Decision.

reusable_evidence: Official TikTok oEmbed is a viable per-known-URL verifier.
Public HTTP application shells are not valid topic discovery.
P57 evidence and CJ7 remain immutable.

allowed_domains: tiktok.com and TikTok-owned public subdomains required by the rendered page
browser_security_contract.first_party_session_cookies: allowed only inside the current temporary context

instructions: Validate KU2D-SCOPE-000005 and P58-01 before editing or making a live operation.
Create source-specific browser lifecycle code by reusing established fresh-profile/CDP patterns without modifying shared runtime or dependencies.
Run one exact-environment preflight and record whether TikTok was reached before any batch.
Execute Round 1 in one temporary context, retain up to five topic-qualified canonical records per topic, officially verify each, then destroy the entire context.
Execute Round 2 in a new temporary context and reproduce/verify the same final record identities; destroy that context independently.
Persist only sanitized metadata, operation summaries, stable public IDs/URLs and boolean destruction proof.
Only after both rounds pass, create the thin adapter/parser/mapper, immutable Registry V3, source/capability/run manifests, sanitized fixture, MTC and Analysis handoff.
Run fixture, lifecycle, security-negative, registry-lineage, invariant, exact-head corpus and CI checks.
Use one PR to integration, squash merge only when technically green, verify the merged tree, close CJ8 and submit KU2D-R-000059.
stop_conditions: network preflight cannot reach TikTok within the preconnect ceiling
provider-reached operations would exceed 40 or preconnect failures would exceed 10
login, credentials, account authorization, CAPTCHA interaction or anti-bot/access-control bypass is required
first-party cookie values, browser profile, storage state, cache, raw netlog, headers or raw bodies would be persisted
round two cannot reproduce the final official record set in a fresh context
a protected shared runner, validator, dependency, V1/V2 registry/manifest/schema or CI workflow must change
production write, recurring scheduling or main modification is required
definition_of_done: all five entered phases have valid seven-field declarations
network preflight passes before any batch
five valid records per topic are obtained with stable IDs, canonical URLs, creators, metadata and timestamps
every retained record is officially verified in two independent fresh contexts
each browser context is destroyed with zero persisted cookie/profile/storage-state evidence
provider-reached and preconnect ledgers remain within separate limits
thin TikTok adapter, capability/source/run manifests, immutable Registry V3, sanitized fixture, MTC and Analysis handoff are complete
P57 inherited evidence remains byte-identical and V1/V2/shared foundation invariants do not drift
targeted tests, exact-head 56-test corpus and Data Acquisition CI pass
KU2D-CJ-000008 closes with no pending links
one green PR squash-merges to integration and post-merge verification passes
